name: Return to Milton
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I need to spend some time studying the Arm of Gri'lek book you brought me, though I'm sure Milton is eager to get the other recovered books into Stormwind's collection.

Here are the books you gathered from the Ruins of Alterac, packed and catalogued.  Take them back to Milton Sheaf in Stormwind and I'm sure he'll be grateful.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Tomes of Alterac to Milton Sheaf in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText:
My oh my! Look at these! I can't believe they survived the ruination of Alterac. And all those ogres too!

Thank you, adventurer. Thank you so much! You have helped preserve human knowledge, and you add to the grandeur of the Royal Library of Stormwind.
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer, you've returned! How did your foray into Alterac go? Did you bring anything back with you?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 25 to 38, 9,300 XP in all.

quests.name: An Old History Book
quests.objectiveText: Return the book: The History of Stormwind, to the Stormwind Library.

quests.name: Southshore
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.

quests.name: Preserving Knowledge
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Recovered Tomes and the Worn Leather Book containing The Arm of Gri'lek to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.

quests.name: Return to Milton
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Tomes of Alterac to Milton Sheaf in Stormwind.
